title: Email: Fw: what HR tells me ...

content.text:
From: Bhatia, Peter <pbhatia@gannett.com>
Sent: Monday, November 25, 2019 1:25 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: what HR tells me ... 
 
I’ll talk to the Guild (and you should, too). BTW, if you went this route we would work with you on a departure date. It wouldn’t have to be right away. Could push into January, for example.
Editor and Vice President, Detroit Free Press and freep.com
Great Lakes regional editor (Michigan and Ohio), USA TODAY Network

From: "Fenech, Anthony" <afenech@freepress.com>
Date: Monday, November 25, 2019 at 1:22 PM
To: "Bhatia, Peter" <pbhatia@gannett.com>
Subject: Re: what HR tells me ...
Thank you for getting back to me so quickly. If I could get a few days, that'd be great.

From: Bhatia, Peter <pbhatia@gannett.com>
Sent: Monday, November 25, 2019 1:17 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: what HR tells me ...
Anthony’s seniority date with the union is 1/2/13.  Looks like he’d be eligible for 14 weeks severance.
Editor and Vice President, Detroit Free Press and freep.com
Great Lakes regional editor (Michigan and Ohio), USA TODAY Network
